Title: Sepsis Early Recognition and the Hour-1 Bundle
Description:
Case-based online module on recognizing sepsis early and starting the Surviving Sepsis Campaign hour-1 bundle.
Includes two branching patient cases and a 10-question post-test.
Keywords: Sepsis [MeSH:D018805]; Shock, Septic [MeSH:D012772]; Early Diagnosis [MeSH:D042241]; triage
Authors: Dr. Amelia Broussard <abroussard@example.org>; Marc Thibodeaux, RN
Publisher: UL Lafayette College of Nursing & Allied Health
Accredited Provider: Acadiana Office of Continuing Medical Education
Learning Objectives: Recognize the SIRS and qSOFA criteria; Start the hour-1 bundle within 60 minutes; Reassess lactate and fluid response

Title: Point-of-Care Ultrasound Skills Workshop
Description: Hands-on, small-group workshop: cardiac, lung and FAST views on live models and simulators.
Authors: Dr. Nadia Fontenot; Dr. Luis Romero
Specialties: emergency medicine; family medicine; internal medicine
Accredited Provider: Acadiana Office of Continuing Medical Education
Learning Objectives: Acquire the parasternal long-axis view; Identify free fluid on the FAST exam

Title: Chest Radiograph: Right Middle Lobe Pneumonia
Description: PA chest radiograph of a 54-year-old with fever and productive cough, showing right middle lobe consolidation silhouetting the right heart border.
Learning Objectives: Recognize the silhouette sign of right middle lobe consolidation

Title: Managing Type 2 Diabetes at Home (Spanish Edition)
Description: Plain-language booklet for adults newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes: checking blood sugar, healthy plates and when to call the clinic.
Keywords: Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2 [MeSH:D003924]; Self Care [MeSH:D012648]; blood sugar
License: Free to copy for patient use
Learning Objectives: Check blood sugar at home; Build a healthy plate

Title: Opioid Stewardship for Pharmacists
Description: Self-paced activity on safe opioid prescribing support, naloxone co-dispensing and PDMP use in community pharmacy.
Learning Objectives: Describe the CDC opioid prescribing recommendations; Counsel patients on naloxone

Title: Pediatric Asthma Action Plans: A Case-Based Review
Description: Video grand rounds with three pediatric asthma cases, from stepwise therapy to writing an action plan families can follow.
Authors: Dr. Simone Guidry; Dr. Ethan Landry
Learning Objectives: Classify asthma severity in children; Write a three-zone asthma action plan
